title: App Settings ON gives access to the admin pages
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the App Settings sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area in the left sidebar.
  3. Look for Departments, Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions and Locations.
custom_expected: The App Settings pages are available: Departments, Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions and Locations.
evidence: UI (role settingsApp): the SETTINGS admin group is present — Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations, Departments. screenshot settings-SetX.
